Contributing

Pixhaus uses a parallel-stream development model: features are independent branches worked by individual contributors or agents. The repo has a detailed contributing guide covering branch naming, commit format, the task queue, and the AI-assisted dispatch workflow.

Read CONTRIBUTING.md → Code of conduct →

Support the project

Pixhaus is MIT-licensed and has no paid tier. Sustainability comes from sponsorships and grant funding — the Krita and Blender model. If Pixhaus is useful to you, consider sponsoring on GitHub Sponsors or Open Collective.
